title: Aspire TSX Replacement Fixed-coil pods - 2 Pack
description: The Aspire Cyber S vape kit is perfect for anyone looking for an easy-to-use, low-maintenance vape device that doesn't skimp on flavour or vapour production. These replacement TSX are compatible with the Aspire Cyber S and Cyber X pod kits and feature a mesh build that heats up quickly, allowing for faster vaporisation of e-liquid and improved flavour production. Refilling these pods is a breeze too - simply remove the rubber stopper on the side to reveal the filling port and top up with your favourite e-liquid. For best results, we recommend pairing these pods with nic salt, 50/50 and classic high PG E-Liquid. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
